subtitle: Out Cebu · China Eastern Airlines
overview: Fly China Eastern Airlines from Cebu via Shanghai to Harbin and stay six nights in 4-star hotels, travelling by private coach with an English-speaking guide. The days cover Harbin Ice and Snow World, the Siberian Tiger Park, Polar Aquarium, Volga Manor, St. Sophia Church Square and the Songhua River, with an afternoon tea and a glass of ice wine and vodka along the way.

placeDesc.Harbin: The capital of Heilongjiang in northeast China, known for its Russian-influenced architecture and winter ice festival.
placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, where winter swimmers can be watched on the ice-covered banks.
placeDesc.Giant Snowman: A giant snowman sculpture in Harbin that went viral online, visited for a photo stop.
placeDesc.Volga Manor: A Russian-themed park near Harbin recreating Russian architecture and culture, with an ice wine and vodka tasting.
placeDesc.Pavlov Castle: A Russian-style castle building within the Volga Manor park.
placeDesc.Pushkin Salon: A Russian-style literary salon at Volga Manor, named after the poet Pushkin.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian-style church at Volga Manor, visited together with other Russian folk sites.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A park in Harbin where Siberian tigers can be viewed from a safari bus.
placeDesc.Harbin Grand Theatre: A modern landmark theatre in Harbin, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Chinese Baroque Historical District: A historic area of Harbin with European-style buildings, visited on foot.
placeDesc.Polar Aquarium: A Harbin aquarium themed on polar animals; entry includes a beluga whale show.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice and Snow World: A large winter park in Harbin with giant ice and snow sculptures, lit up in the evening.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic railway bridge over the Songhua River, built in the early 20th century.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park along the Songhua River in Harbin.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua riverside in Harbin, commemorating the city's 1957 flood defence.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's famous pedestrian street with European-style buildings, shops and cafes.
placeDesc.St. Sophia Church Square: The square in front of Harbin's well-known Russian Orthodox church, visited as a photo stop.
